intro.title: Getting to know YolUp
intro.intro: Everything in YolUp lives in four sections: lessons, group chats, homework and tests.
steps: “Home” — today's lessons, upcoming homework and the latest news.
“Chats” — group chats and direct messages.
“Schedule” — lessons and tests by day, week or month.
“Workspace” — homework, tests, materials and results.
intro.tip: Tip: tap your profile photo to open settings and the help center.

joinGroup.title: How do I join a group?
joinGroup.intro: You join a group with the invite code or link from your teacher.
steps: Open “Chats”.
Tap “Join a group”.
Enter the code from your teacher — the group chat appears in the list.

createGroup.title: How do I create a group?
createGroup.intro: A new group automatically gets a chat, a schedule and a homework section.
steps: Open “Chats”.
Tap “+” at the top and choose a new group.
Enter the group name and subject.
Tap “Create” — the group appears in the list.

addStudent.title: How do I add a student?
addStudent.intro: Invite students with a code or add them yourself.
steps: Open the group chat.
Choose “Add a student” in the group menu.
Send the invite code to the student or pick them from the list.

parentStart.title: How do I connect my child?
parentStart.hint: Add a child → login or FK code
parentStart.intro: Connect your child's account to see their lessons, grades and homework.
steps: Tap “Add a child” on the home page.
Enter your child's login (username) or the FK-… invite code.
Confirm — your child's data appears on the home page.

language.title: How do I change the app language?
language.intro: The app works in Uzbek, Russian and English.
steps: Open Profile → “System settings”.
Tap “Language”.
Choose a language — the app switches right away.

joinLesson.title: How do I join a lesson?
joinLesson.intro: You can join a live lesson after the teacher starts it.
steps: Find the lesson in “Schedule”.
Open the lesson card and tap “Join the lesson”.
Check your camera and microphone and tap “Enter”.
joinLesson.tip: Tip: if the lesson hasn't started yet, a waiting screen opens and you join as soon as the teacher starts.

startLesson.title: How do I start a lesson?
startLesson.intro: The lesson starts when you enter the room, and students get a notification.
steps: Open the lesson on “Home” or in “Schedule”.
Tap “Start the lesson”.
Check your camera and microphone.
Tap “Enter” — the lesson goes live and students can join.
startLesson.tip: Tip: allow screen sharing to record the lesson.

createLesson.title: How do I add a lesson?
createLesson.intro: Add a single lesson, a repeating schedule or several lessons at once.
steps: Open “Schedule”.
Tap “Add a lesson”.
Choose the group and the mode: single, repeating or several lessons.
Set the date and time and save.

cancelLesson.title: How do I cancel a lesson?
cancelLesson.intro: Only a lesson that hasn't started yet can be cancelled.
steps: Open the lesson in “Schedule”.
Tap “Cancel”.
Choose this lesson only or the whole series and confirm.

recordings.title: Where can I watch a lesson recording?
recordings.intro: Recorded lessons are saved in materials once they are ready.
steps: Open “Workspace” → “Materials”.
Choose the group and the lesson folder.
Open the video recording.

schedule.title: How do I see the schedule?
schedule.intro: The schedule shows lessons and tests assigned to groups together.
steps: Open “Schedule”.
Choose the day, week or month view.
Tap a lesson or a test to see the details.

submitHomework.title: How do I submit homework?
submitHomework.intro: You can submit homework in the app in a few seconds: a file, a photo or plain text.
steps: Open Workspace → Homework.
Choose the homework and tap “Submit”.
Add a file, a photo or text.
Tap “Send” — your teacher gets a notification.
submitHomework.tip: Tip: keep each file under 20 MB.

lateHomework.title: What if the deadline has passed?
lateHomework.intro: If the teacher allows it, you can submit after the deadline — it is marked as late.
steps: Open the homework and check whether the “Submit” button is there.
If it isn't, write to your teacher in the group chat.

resubmit.title: Resubmitting homework
resubmit.intro: If the teacher asks you to resubmit, you get a notification.
steps: Open the notification or the homework.
Read the teacher's comment.
Add a new answer and send it again.

createHomework.title: How do I give homework?
createHomework.intro: Homework can include text, a file, a voice note and test questions.
steps: Open Workspace → Homework.
Tap “New homework”.
Choose the group, the deadline and the grading type.
Write the text and tap “Save” — students get a notification.

checkHomework.title: How do I check homework?
checkHomework.hint: AI suggests, you set the grade
checkHomework.intro: Submitted answers appear on the homework page.
steps: Open the homework and see who submitted.
Open a student's answer — an AI suggestion appears if there is one.
Set the grade and a comment and save.

aiCheck.title: How does the AI check work?
aiCheck.intro: If “AI check” is on for the homework, AI reviews the answer and suggests feedback and an estimated grade.
steps: The student sends an answer.
AI checks it within a few minutes.
The teacher confirms or changes the final grade.

takeTest.title: How do I take a test?
takeTest.intro: A test can be taken from its opening time until the deadline.
steps: Open Workspace → Tests.
Choose the test and tap “Solve”.
Answer the questions and tap “Finish”.

testResults.title: Where can I see my test result?
testResults.intro: The result appears right after the test is finished.
steps: Open Workspace → Tests.
Open a finished test to see the score and answers.

assignTest.title: How do I assign a test to a group?
assignTest.intro: One test can be assigned to any number of groups — each group gets its own copy.
steps: Open Workspace → Tests.
Choose the test and tap “Assign to a group”.
Choose the group, the opening time and the deadline and send.

paymentQuestion.title: I have a payment question
paymentQuestion.intro: Write to support about any payment question.
steps: Tap “Send a request”.
Choose the “Payments” topic.
Describe your question in detail and send it.

paymentCharged.title: The payment failed but money was charged
paymentCharged.hint: Send a request with the receipt
paymentCharged.intro: If money was charged but the course didn't open, a specialist will check the payment.
steps: Tap “Send a request” and choose the “Payments” topic.
Write the payment date and amount.
Attach a screenshot of the receipt and send.

forgotPassword.title: I forgot my password, what do I do?
forgotPassword.intro: You reset the password with a code sent to your email.
steps: Tap “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.
Enter the email linked to your account.
Enter the code from the email.
Set a new password and sign in.
forgotPassword.tip: Tip: if your email isn't verified, the code won't arrive — write to support.

changePassword.title: How do I change my password?
changePassword.intro: You can change your password any time in profile settings.
steps: Open Profile → “Account settings”.
Tap “Change password” under “Security”.
Enter the current and new password and save.

emailLogin.title: I can't sign in with my email
emailLogin.intro: You can sign in with email only if it is verified.
steps: Sign in with your login (username).
Verify your email in the profile with a code.
Next time you can sign in with email too.
emailLogin.tip: Tip: if one email is linked to several accounts, sign in with your login.

switchAccount.title: How do I switch accounts?
switchAccount.intro: If you have several roles (for example teacher and parent), you switch between them without a password.
steps: Open your profile.
Tap “Switch account”.
Choose an account or open a new role.

loginHistory.title: How do I see who signed in?
loginHistory.intro: Sign-in history shows devices and the time of last activity.
steps: Open Profile → “Sign-in history”.
If you see an unknown device, change your password right away.

notifications.title: Notifications don't arrive
notifications.intro: Notifications must be enabled in the app and in the browser.
steps: Open Profile → “System settings” → “Notifications”.
Turn on the notifications you need.
Allow notifications if the browser asks.

cameraMic.title: The camera or microphone doesn't work
cameraMic.intro: Most often the browser hasn't allowed the camera or microphone.
steps: Click the lock icon in the address bar.
Allow the camera and microphone.
Reload the page and join the lesson again.

blankScreen.title: The page won't open or shows a blank screen
blankScreen.hint: Reload the page and clear the cache
blankScreen.intro: If an old version is stuck in the cache, the page may not open properly.
steps: Reload the page with Ctrl+Shift+R (Cmd+Shift+R on Mac).
Update your browser to the latest version.
If it still happens, send a request with a screenshot.

fileUpload.title: A file won't upload
fileUpload.hint: Check the size and your internet
fileUpload.intro: If the file is too large or the internet is slow, the upload may stop.
steps: Check the file size.
Check your internet connection and try again.
If an error message appears, include it in your request.
fileUpload.tip: Tip: in chat a file can be up to 20 MB and a video up to 50 MB.

parentAttendance.title: How do I see if my child attended a lesson?
parentAttendance.intro: The Attendance section shows your child's lessons and attendance.
steps: Open “Attendance” in the menu.
Choose your child at the top if needed.
Tap a lesson to see the details.

parentHomework.title: Where can I see my child's homework?
parentHomework.intro: The Homework section shows assigned, submitted and overdue homework.
steps: Open “Homework” in the menu.
Choose a homework to see its status and the teacher's grade.

parentResults.title: Where can I see grades and test results?
parentResults.intro: The Results section collects grades by subject and test results.
steps: Open “Results” in the menu.
Choose a subject to see detailed results.
